intervention_label: HER2 reconciliation (retrieve the 2026-08 validated IHC tier; 4B5 + reflex ISH on contemporary tissue) + full sequencing-report retrieval (FGFR3/FGFR2, the unnamed OncoKB-actionable alteration, ERBB2 copy number) — decision gate
expected_benefit: Not a therapy — resolves the two gates the whole case hangs on. The validated 2026-08 HER2 stain is already drawn and only its tier is unretrieved (days for a records request; 3-7 days if a block must be recut), and FGFR3 status plus the single OncoKB-actionable alteration sit unread in sequencing reports generated in 2023-2025. Costs records requests and at most one block cut.
key_risks: None — records retrieval plus IHC on existing tissue

Specimen-sufficiency caveat: the 2026-08 nodal core carries 5-10% tumor content and can under-read a membrane stain; tumor content must be stated on the report (second-site read on the 2025-03 recurrence block hedges this)
A HER2 downgrade to 2+/1+ moves the HER2 recs below onto weaker cross-tumor footing and takes T-DXd off its tumor-agnostic label
preference_alignment: Matches the free-text decision gates (1) and (3) verbatim; runs on records, blood and archival tissue, which is what the tissue-scarcity constraint asks for.
guideline_status: The T-DXd tumor-agnostic label and its NCCN Bladder Cancer v1.2026 listing are written for validated IHC 3+; NCCN/ESMO carry erdafitinib only for FGFR-altered tumors — both gates run through this workup.
rationale_summary: All five personas conditioned their entire rankings on this step: four made T-DXd continuation contingent on the re-stain tier, and every board member flagged the unretrieved sequencing reports as the cheapest evidence upgrade in the case (the critic: 'none of my four picks survives unchanged if those reads come back adverse'). The weak HER2 on 2026-08 research-grade MXIF is not a validated assay and cannot settle the question either way; three validated 3+ results describe 2023-2025 tumor, not the current one. The sequencing retrieval could also surface an FGFR3 alteration (~15-20% prior) that opens a guideline-carried oral option and would reorder the board's whole list. No dissent anywhere on this row.
open_questions: Whether the 2026-08 nodal core's 5-10% tumor content supports a reliable tier, or the 2025-03 recurrence block must serve as the read
Identity of the single OncoKB-actionable alteration the 2023 report counted but never named
ERBB2 copy number among the 12-13 unnamed copy-number alterations
likelihood_of_effect: Certain to inform: the tier decides on-label versus cross-tumor footing for every HER2 row, and the FGFR3 readout could open the strongest genomic branch (NCT05614739).
toxicity_burden: Low (none — records retrieval and IHC on existing tissue)

counter_productive_moa.description: Workup, not a therapy.

overall: Both gating answers already exist in a drawn stain and unretrieved reports; retrieving them beats spending scarce tissue or a trial slot on any branch below.

intervention_label: zanidatamab (HER2 biparatopic bispecific, payload-free) — off-label or NCT06695845 fallback if 3+ holds but T-DXd stops
scenario_label: If contemporary validated HER2 IHC reads 3+
expected_benefit: ORR 37.0% (95% CI 27.0-48.7) across HER2-expressing solid tumors in the phase 1 (n=132), driven largely by biliary tract cancer; durability in urothelial carcinoma unknown. Activity after T-DXd exposure is untested.
key_risks: Benign phase-1 safety file: six grade-3 treatment-related events in 4 of 132 patients, no treatment-related deaths
Standard LVEF monitoring; infusion reactions
Post-approval safety follow-up under two years (biliary accelerated approval 2024-11)
preference_alignment: Touches none of the four stated vetoes (no cytotoxic payload). prefers_trials: PARTIAL — the registered pan-tumor cohort bars prior HER2-directed therapy, so the realistic route after T-DXd is off-label prescription.
guideline_status: FDA accelerated approval in previously treated HER2-positive (IHC 3+) biliary tract cancer only; off-guideline in urothelial carcinoma.
rationale_summary: Conservative and concensusite both ranked this as the payload-free way to stay on a confirmed HER2 axis if the re-stain holds 3+ but GI intolerance forces a T-DXd stop; neither ranked it with confidence above 'low', and no other persona engaged it. The evidence is first-in-human single-arm with the 37% ORR weighted toward biliary histology, and the phase-2 basket cohort that names urothelial carcinoma excludes prior HER2-directed therapy — current T-DXd forecloses it, leaving an off-label payer case that collapses if the tier drops below 3+. Conditional on her2_ihc:positive; foreclosed if the contemporary stain reads low.
open_questions: Activity of a payload-free HER2 bispecific after progression or intolerance on a HER2 ADC
Whether the sponsor will grant a protocol exception for prior T-DXd, or the route is off-label from the start
likelihood_of_effect: Moderate if 3+ holds: ORR 37.0% (95% CI 27.0-48.7) in phase 1 (pmid:36400106), biliary-weighted; untested after T-DXd.
toxicity_burden: Low (grade-3 TRAEs in 4/132, no treatment-related deaths; LVEF monitoring)

counter_productive_moa.description: ADC-selected HER2 downregulation would blunt a payload-free bispecific; untested after T-DXd.

overall: The payload-free way to stay on a confirmed HER2 3+ axis when T-DXd stops for tolerability — clean safety file, thin urothelial evidence, trial door closed by prior T-DXd.

intervention_label: [225Ac]Ac-AKY-1189 (Nectin-4 actinium-225 radioligand) with [64Cu]Cu-AKY-1189 imaging — NCT07020117
expected_benefit: None quotable — first-in-human dose escalation with no efficacy data. The [64Cu] imaging step answers whether the current tumor still carries Nectin-4 with a scan instead of a slide, and prior enfortumab vedotin is explicitly permitted.
key_risks: No human safety data at any dose; enrollment at a subtherapeutic dose level is possible
Alpha-radioligand marrow exposure in a patient with a 2025 iron-deficiency anemia history and platelets 170
Renal handling unquantified — creatinine/eGFR absent from the record, with prior obstructive uropathy
Measurable RECIST disease after SBRT to the only known nodal sites is a real screening gate; ~3-week washout from T-DXd
preference_alignment: Strong preference fit: prefers_trials YES; no MMAE, no deruxtecan payload, so no stated veto is touched; imaging-based screening spends no tissue, matching the tissue-scarcity constraint.
guideline_status: Investigational; no approval or guideline standing anywhere.
rationale_summary: Risktaker (rank 3) and advocate (rank 2) converged on the same argument: an alpha emitter kills by crossfire, so it needs neither uniform antigen nor internalization — the insurance policy if 25 months of EV thinned Nectin-4 expression — and it is nearly the only Nectin-4 protocol that permits prior EV. Conservative's blanket position against first-in-human radioligands (no post-marketing safety file) and the critic's silence mean the endorsement base is the board's two most aggressive voices. Both ranked it on mechanism and preference fit, not on a number; the 2026-06 Nectin-4 imaging read, if retrieved, could make the screening visit unnecessary or much more attractive.
open_questions: Retrieval of the 2026-06 Nectin-4-directed imaging read
Renal function (creatinine/eGFR not in the available record)
Whether a measurable target lesion exists after SBRT
Sequencing against the T-DXd stop decision (washout forces it)
likelihood_of_effect: Unknown — first-in-human with zero efficacy data; a mechanism bet that alpha crossfire survives partial Nectin-4 loss after 25 months of EV (pmid:41173324).
toxicity_burden: Moderate (no human safety table; alpha-radioligand class marrow suppression and renal exposure, with eGFR unmeasured)

counter_productive_moa.description: Subtherapeutic dose-escalation assignment could spend the post-T-DXd window without benefit.

overall: The one Nectin-4 route insulated from both MMAE neuropathy and antigen heterogeneity, with an imaging step that answers the expression question tissue-free — and no efficacy data at all.

intervention_label: CLSP-1025 (TP53 R175H x HLA-A*02:01 T-cell engager) — GUARDIAN-101, NCT06778863
expected_benefit: None quotable — no clinical data for CLSP-1025 or any agent in its class. The only human precedent on the axis is a single TCR-T patient with a 55% regression lasting 6 months (pmid:35749374). Both eligibility gates are already answered on paper: HLA-A*02:01 (2025-01 typing) and TP53 R175H (2025-06 plasma).
key_risks: Cytokine release syndrome expected; inpatient step-up dosing
Off-tumor behavior in humans unknown; dose escalation may enroll at a subtherapeutic level
Very low peptide-HLA copy number per tumor cell — the obstacle the preclinical lineage itself flags
preference_alignment: Strong experimental-posture fit: off-the-shelf (no apheresis slot or manufacturing wait), screens on existing records rather than fresh tissue, four sites in the usual care orbit. No stated toxicity veto is touched.
guideline_status: Investigational; no approval or guideline standing anywhere.
rationale_summary: Risktaker (rank 5) and advocate (rank 3) both ranked it as the shot at a truncal driver the tumor cannot shed the way it sheds a surface antigen, resting on an unusually deep preclinical package (structure-resolved specificity, affinity-optimized formats). The predictive-certainty hedge is load-bearing and both personas said so: the R175H call rests on a single plasma read at 0.09% VAF — a weak, low-positive-grade predictor that could be subclonal or fail the sponsor's central confirmation — and tissue-level confirmation should be pulled from the existing 2023 NGS report before a screening slot is spent. The critic's round-1 notes declined the whole class for having no published clinical results; that objection stands and is why this sits below the Nectin-4 radioligand despite identical board arithmetic.
open_questions: Tissue confirmation of TP53 R175H from the existing NGS report (0.09% VAF plasma is the only current source)
Tumor HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity — computable from existing exome data; if lost, this row and the PRAME axis weaken together
Compatibility of the ongoing mRNA vaccine series with trial exclusions
likelihood_of_effect: Unknown, and gated twice: no clinical data for the class, and the R175H call is one 0.09% VAF plasma read pending tissue confirmation.
toxicity_burden: Moderate (expected CRS with inpatient step-up dosing; no human safety table yet)

counter_productive_moa.description: Very low peptide-HLA density and unmeasured HLA-A*02 LOH could cap engager potency.

overall: A truncal-driver bet with both eligibility gates already on file — but the R175H call is a single 0.09% VAF plasma read and the class has no clinical results yet.

intervention_label: LY4052031 (Nectin-4 ADC, camptothecin topoisomerase-I payload) — NEXUS-01 cohort B2, NCT06465069
expected_benefit: Post-EV ORR 47% at 3.6 mg/kg in the NEXUS-01 dose escalation — an ASCO 2026 abstract figure, unpublished, no confidence interval; regression toward something smaller is likely. The target axis carries two randomized phase 3 OS wins with a different agent (EV-301 HR 0.70, p=0.001; EV-302 HR 0.47, p<0.001).
key_risks: No published safety table for the camptothecin payload; class GI toxicity (diarrhea, nausea, neutropenia) lands on an active severe-nausea problem
Back-to-back topoisomerase-I payloads after T-DXd are unstudied — cross-resistance and cumulative toxicity both open
Measurable disease required for cohort B2; the only known nodal sites were irradiated 2026-06
Corneal keratopathy exclusion
preference_alignment: Best efficacy-weighted fit on the board for a 0.7 efficacy weight with prefers_trials true: cohort B2 requires prior EV rather than excluding it, the payload avoids MMAE and the neuropathy veto, and screening runs on histology and prior therapy, not fresh tissue. Six Northeast sites including MSK and MGH.
guideline_status: Investigational; no approval or guideline standing anywhere.
rationale_summary: Three personas ranked it (advocate 1st, risktaker 2nd, critic 3rd) on the best-validated target in the dossier — the axis behind this patient's own 25-month complete response, with post-EV resistance biology favoring retained Nectin-4 (efflux and uptake defects rather than antigen loss, pmid:42167230). Conservative dissented that rank-1-grade weight exceeds what an unpublished 47% dose-escalation figure can carry with no safety table against an active GI problem, and concensusite dissented that a phase 1 slot should not outrank the guideline-listed option; the critic, while ranking it, insisted the 47% is a screening lead and not an estimate, and that both Nectin-4 stains predate EV exposure (primary-to-node IHC agreement kappa 0.41). The synthesis keeps it as the strongest live trial lead, screened in parallel rather than as a reason to stop anything: enrollment cannot be discussed until the T-DXd stop decision is made.
open_questions: Contemporary Nectin-4 expression after ~25 months of EV (retrieve the 2026-06 imaging read before spending a slot)
Whether a measurable lesion outside the SBRT field exists
Deruxtecan-to-camptothecin payload cross-resistance — ask the investigator directly
The published safety table, when it exists
likelihood_of_effect: Moderate but unstable: 47% post-EV ORR is unpublished dose-escalation data (NCT06465069); target validation is RCT-grade, the agent estimate is not.
toxicity_burden: Moderate (camptothecin-class diarrhea, nausea, neutropenia; no published safety table yet)

counter_productive_moa.description: Sequential topoisomerase-I payloads after T-DXd risk cross-resistance; current Nectin-4 expression unverified.

overall: The trial written for his exact post-EV history with a payload that clears the neuropathy veto — carried by RCT-grade target validation, not by published data on this drug.

intervention_label: pertuzumab + trastuzumab (payload-free HER2 doublet) — TAPUR HER2 arm NCT02693535 or off-label, pending the ERBB2 report
scenario_label: If contemporary HER2 IHC reads 3+, or 2+ with ERBB2 amplification on the retrieved report
expected_benefit: MyPathway: ORR 41.0% in HER2-amplified IHC 3+ tumors, 25.9% overall, 8.3% at IHC 1+, 0% at IHC 0; two of the five complete responses were urothelial. No data after HER2-ADC exposure.
key_risks: Diarrhea 36.1%, fatigue 29.4%, nausea 22.4% any-grade in MyPathway; no single serious term above 1.7%
Standard LVEF monitoring algorithm
KRAS status confounds the pooled estimate (28.1% wild-type vs 7.1% mutant)
preference_alignment: The only HER2 option in the dossier touching none of the four stated vetoes; TAPUR gives a protocolized access route (ECOG 0-2, broad sites). prefers_trials: YES via TAPUR. Efficacy fit at 0.7 weight: PARTIAL — the pooled ORR is modest and post-T-DXd activity is untested.
guideline_status: Off-guideline in urothelial carcinoma; both antibodies FDA-approved elsewhere with 13+ years of post-marketing data; TAPUR is the protocolized route.
rationale_summary: Conservative ranked it second as the safest HER2 route (decade-plus safety files, payload-free, no veto contact) and the critic fourth for the same tier-gradient data that anchors the whole HER2 case. Risktaker dissented on preference fit: a 25.9% pooled ORR with no post-T-DXd data sitting above the Nectin-4 axis presses the counterweight past what a 0.7 efficacy weight bears — a placement objection the synthesis absorbs by ranking it below the trial leads. Doubly conditional: the TAPUR arm turns on ERBB2 amplification or overexpression documented in the still-unretrieved NGS report, and the MyPathway tier gradient means the pending re-stain decides whether this option has a floor at all. Naked-antibody activity after a HER2 ADC is undocumented; ADC-resistant tumors may have selected against the target.
open_questions: ERBB2 amplification status in the unretrieved 2023 report (the TAPUR gate)
Naked-antibody activity after T-DXd exposure in urothelial carcinoma
likelihood_of_effect: Moderate at amplified 3+ (ORR 41.0%, MyPathway pmid:37793085); collapses to 8.3% at 1+; untested after a HER2 ADC.
toxicity_burden: Low (diarrhea 36.1% mostly low-grade; no serious term above 1.7%; LVEF monitoring)

counter_productive_moa.description: ADC-selected HER2 loss would gut a naked-antibody doublet; the tier gradient is steep.

overall: The one HER2 route that touches none of the four vetoes, with a protocolized TAPUR path — its floor set by the pending tier and the unread ERBB2 copy number.

intervention_label: FGFR3 axis, conditional on the sequencing retrieval: vepugratinib (LOXO-435) FORAGER-1 NCT05614739 as the investigational arm (erdafitinib, if an alteration is found, is the approved default and belongs to the standard-of-care table)
expected_benefit: None quotable yet — wholly conditional on the rank-1 records retrieval. Roughly 15-20% of metastatic urothelial carcinoma carries a qualifying FGFR3 alteration; if this tumor does, the FGFR axis becomes the strongest non-HER2 genomic branch in the case, and cohort B7 (FGFR3 + HER2 expression) is the one registry slot where both of this patient's axes meet.
key_risks: FGFR-inhibitor class effects (hyperphosphatemia, stomatitis, nail and eye toxicity); no vepugratinib safety table in the dossier
Expected yield is modest: ~80-85% probability no qualifying alteration exists
preference_alignment: prefers_trials: YES; oral targeted option with no stated veto contact. Fully aligned with free-text decision gate (3): retrieve the NGS report.
guideline_status: ESMO (Ann Oncol 2024 interim update) and NCCN Bladder Cancer v1.2026 both carry erdafitinib for susceptible FGFR3 alterations after EV + pembrolizumab — the only other biomarker route both bodies endorse in this disease; vepugratinib itself is phase 1 and off-guideline.
rationale_summary: Concensusite's rank 2 and every other persona's notes converge here without a single dissent: FGFR3 status is simply missing from the derived record, the answer already exists in reports nobody has retrieved, and finding an alteration would reorder the whole board (risktaker: 'that records request could reorder everything above'; advocate: 'FORAGER-1 cohort B7 or erdafitinib would displace most of this list'). The consensus standing belongs to erdafitinib, which is approved and guideline-carried and therefore routed to the standard-of-care table; this row holds the investigational escalation. An FGFR3 alteration found on a laboratory-developed panel may still need confirmation on the approved companion assay before treatment.
open_questions: FGFR3/FGFR2 status in the unretrieved reports (the entire gate)
Companion-assay confirmation if an alteration is found on a laboratory-developed panel
likelihood_of_effect: Conditional: ~15-20% chance a qualifying FGFR3 alteration exists; if found, both guideline bodies endorse the axis in exactly this line (NCT05614739).
toxicity_burden: Moderate (FGFR-class hyperphosphatemia, stomatitis, nail and eye toxicity; no agent-specific table in the dossier)

counter_productive_moa.description: None plausible before the gate; expected yield is the limiter.

overall: A records request away from being real: FGFR3 status is simply unread, and the FGFR axis is the only non-HER2 route both major guidelines endorse in this line.

intervention_label: FT825 / ONO-8250 (off-the-shelf iPSC-derived HER2 CAR-T) — NCT06241456
scenario_label: If contemporary HER2 IHC confirms expression at the protocol's tier
expected_benefit: None quotable — phase 1 dose escalation with no urothelial efficacy signal. Allogeneic product: no apheresis, no manufacturing wait, and prior HER2-directed therapy is not an exclusion, which separates it from every HER2 antibody/ADC protocol in the registry.
key_risks: Lymphodepleting conditioning chemotherapy with its cytopenia window
Cytokine release syndrome
The prior cell-or-gene-therapy exclusion is a live question against two ongoing vaccine programs — ask before booking a screening slot
preference_alignment: prefers_trials: YES; Yale, MSK and Jefferson are within the care orbit; no deruxtecan payload to argue with the unresolved chest CT. Conditioning toxicity is accepted by the stated experimental posture but touches the efficacy-toxicity weight.
guideline_status: Investigational; no approval or guideline standing anywhere.
rationale_summary: Advocate alone ranked it, as the HER2 route that survives the file's constraints if the axis continues at all: allogeneic (no apheresis), no payload to trip the ILD or GI vetoes, and open to prior HER2 therapy. It still waits on the pending validated tier, because HER2 benefit tracks the stain across every dataset in this dossier (61.3% at central 3+ in DESTINY-PanTumor02; 41% falling to 8.3% by tier in MyPathway). Conservative's blanket decline of all phase-1 cell therapy and the critic's silence cap the endorsement at one persona; the vaccine-series exclusion question has to be answered before screening.
open_questions: Whether the ongoing mRNA vaccine series trips the prior-gene-therapy exclusion
The HER2 expression tier the protocol requires for urothelial entry
likelihood_of_effect: Unknown — phase 1 with no urothelial signal; benefit is expected to track the pending HER2 tier (pmid:37870536).
toxicity_burden: High (lymphodepletion cytopenias and CRS; no mature safety table)

counter_productive_moa.description: Lymphodepletion could blunt the concurrently primed vaccine T-cell axis.

overall: The HER2 cell-therapy route that survives the file's constraints — no apheresis, no deruxtecan payload — and nothing measured in urothelial cancer yet.

intervention_label: ASP2998 (TROP2-directed STING agonist conjugate) — NCT07287995, monotherapy or pembrolizumab arm; EV combination arms declined in writing
expected_benefit: None quotable — phase 1 with no efficacy data. Urothelial carcinoma is a named escalation and expansion histology with no cap on prior regimens, and prior TROP2- or topoisomerase-I-directed therapy is explicitly permitted, so the T-DXd course does not close this door the way it closes most TROP2 rows.
key_risks: Immune-agonist payload in a patient with 2025 checkpoint-associated pancreatitis — q3-4wk lipase surveillance belongs in the plan
Assignment to an enfortumab vedotin combination arm would violate the neuropathy veto; the arm preference must be settled before consent
No human safety data
preference_alignment: prefers_trials: YES; New York and New Jersey sites. The stated GI and pancreatitis vetoes are engaged as monitoring conditions, not exclusions.
guideline_status: Investigational; no approval or guideline standing anywhere.
rationale_summary: Advocate alone ranked it, as the TROP2 door that stays open after T-DXd: a STING-agonist payload is a different bet from a cytotoxic ADC and should depend less on antigen density, which suits a weak stain. The low-positive hedge is load-bearing: this patient's TROP2 signal sits below almost the entire TROPHY-U-01 distribution, and expression-agnostic entry is not the same as expression-agnostic benefit (pmid:39086310) — the pending validated 2026-08 TROP2 tier should be retrieved before weighting this axis. No other persona engaged the row; the critic's class-level caution about TROP2 surrogates and the conservative's phase-1 decline both apply.
open_questions: The validated 2026-08 TROP2 IHC tier (drawn, unretrieved) — calibrates the whole axis
Whether monotherapy or the pembrolizumab arm is the intended assignment
likelihood_of_effect: Low-to-unknown: no clinical data, and low-positive TROP2 is a weaker predictor even where entry is expression-agnostic (pmid:39086310).
toxicity_burden: Moderate (no human data; immune-agonist class inflammatory events with a pancreatitis-history watch)

counter_productive_moa.description: Weak TROP2 may limit conjugate delivery regardless of payload class.

overall: The TROP2 door that stays open after T-DXd — expression-agnostic entry, with the low-positive hedge stated and the MMAE combination arms declined in writing.

intervention_label: nivolumab + ipilimumab checkpoint re-intensification — lower-ipilimumab schedule with protocolized amylase/lipase surveillance and written stopping rules; the nivo1/ipi3 boost is vetoed and stays off the table
expected_benefit: TITAN-TCC: ITT ORR 33% (90% CI 24-42, p=0.0049 against a prespecified 20% bar) with ipilimumab-3 boosts after PD-1 failure; CheckMate 032 shows the dose-response (38.0% at nivo1/ipi3 vs 26.9% at nivo3/ipi1 vs 25.6% nivolumab alone). The ranked lower-ipilimumab schedule has no efficacy signal of its own — the arm that beat monotherapy is the vetoed one.
key_risks: Grade 3-4 immune enterocolitis 11% with both treatment-related deaths (2/83) in TITAN-TCC — squarely on the severe-GI veto
Grade 3-4 TRAEs 39.1% at nivo1/ipi3 in CheckMate 032
Immune-mediated pancreatitis rechallenge risk (2025 lipase peak 384 U/L) — on the stated pancreatitis veto
Off-label: no NCCN listing in urothelial carcinoma, so the irAE monitoring scaffold and the payer case are both self-assembled
preference_alignment: Conflicted: matches the experimental, efficacy-leaning posture and the care team is already exploring it, but it is the one option engaging two stated toxicity vetoes at once; prefers_trials points to NCT03866382 (cabozantinib + nivo/ipi, variant-histology cohorts) as the protocolized route, though its ~50% variant-morphology threshold may not be met by focal plasmacytoid/giant-cell areas.
guideline_status: No NCCN Bladder Cancer v1.2026 listing in any line; both supporting trials enrolled post-platinum patients — a line this patient skipped.
rationale_summary: Two vetoes are on record and neither is silently dropped: conservative vetoed the nivo1/ipi3 boost outright ('lifted only for a lower-ipilimumab schedule with protocolized amylase/lipase surveillance and written stopping rules'), and advocate vetoed the same schedule for engaging the severe-GI and pancreatitis vetoes at once, naming the identical lower-dose, stopping-rules form as the only acceptable one. This row is that form — the override is the modification both vetoing personas specified, so the boost itself remains not recommended. The cost is the critic's standing objection: every response signal in the class came from ipilimumab 3 mg/kg, and the low-ipilimumab cohort of CheckMate 032 responded at 26.9% versus 25.6% for monotherapy — cutting the dose deletes the only arm that ever beat monotherapy while keeping added irAE exposure. Concensusite's dissent persists on guideline grounds (no listing, population transfer from post-platinum, post-nivolumab trials). Prescribable today with no screening gate, which is why three personas ranked it; the efficacy evidence and the vetoes attach to the same schedule.
open_questions: Whether focal plasmacytoid/giant-cell morphology meets the ~50% variant threshold for NCT03866382 cohorts
Quantified pancreatitis-rechallenge risk on CTLA-4 addition after the 2025 event
Any efficacy evidence for a lower-ipilimumab schedule in this setting (none exists in the dossier)
likelihood_of_effect: Uncertain: the 33% ORR (pmid:36868252) belongs to the vetoed ipi-3 boost in post-platinum, post-nivolumab patients; the tolerable schedule never beat monotherapy.
toxicity_burden: High (immune enterocolitis 11% grade 3-4 with 2/83 treatment-related deaths at ipi-3; pancreatitis rechallenge risk)

counter_productive_moa.description: Dose-reducing ipilimumab may delete the CTLA-4 contribution that ever beat PD-1 monotherapy.

overall: Prescribable now with no screening gate, but the efficacy evidence and both vetoes attach to the same high-dose schedule; the tolerable version is the unproven one.

intervention_label: sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) phase 3 randomized trial — NCT07419295 (TROP2 axis via randomization)
expected_benefit: None applicable as ranked. Concensusite's argument — where consensus is absent, the guideline-aligned move is randomized enrollment — is recorded, but the trial cannot deliver it for this patient.
key_risks: Comparator arm is paclitaxel, docetaxel or vinflunine: two of three control drugs are taxanes against established CIPN
Class precedent is negative: TROPiCS-04 missed OS (HR 0.86, p=0.087) with grade-5 TEAEs 7%, and the urothelial approval was withdrawn 2024
Back-to-back topoisomerase-I payloads after T-DXd unstudied
preference_alignment: Fails the stated neuropathy veto by construction: randomization can assign a taxane the patient cannot opt out of. prefers_trials does not extend to a coin flip onto a vetoed drug class.
guideline_status: The randomized-trial route is the guideline-consistent path to an unendorsed class, but entry requires prior platinum, which this patient never received.
rationale_summary: Risktaker's veto stands and is not overridden: consenting to randomization means accepting a control-arm assignment the preference file forbids, and calling that risk 'inherent to randomization' concedes the point rather than answering it. Conservative and advocate dissented on the same ground independently. The row is also moot on eligibility — the protocol requires prior platinum, anti-PD-(L)1 and enfortumab vedotin, and the platinum line was never given, a gap that recurs across the registered post-EV urothelial trials and is worth flagging to the treating team as a strategic question. Kept in the table not_recommended so the considered-and-rejected path is visible.
open_questions: Whether any future sac-TMT cohort opens without a taxane comparator or a platinum requirement
likelihood_of_effect: Not applicable as ranked: ineligible (no prior platinum) and the randomization veto stands; class OS evidence is negative (pmid:39934055).
toxicity_burden: High (potential taxane-arm CIPN on randomization; class grade-5 TEAEs 7% in TROPiCS-04)

counter_productive_moa.description: Taxane-arm assignment would inflict the vetoed neuropathy and could end all ADC options after.

overall: Randomized entry is the guideline-clean route to TROP2, but this trial can assign a taxane he cannot take and requires platinum he never had.

intervention_label: personalized neoantigen vaccine programs (peptide 2025 + mRNA 2026 series) — continuation of the already-running investigational adjunct, with the post-mRNA EliSpot as the branch point
expected_benefit: No objective-response evidence attributable to vaccination in this patient; EliSpot at 4 months showed CD4+ responses in 2 of 14 evaluable pools, CD4-skewed, and ctDNA rose through most of the vaccine period. Randomized support for the class is adjuvant melanoma (RFS HR ~0.51, durable at 5 years), not metastatic urothelial carcinoma.
key_risks: Injection-site and constitutional reactions (class profile in the cited trials)
Opportunity cost: trial exclusions elsewhere (prior gene therapy questions) interact with continued dosing
preference_alignment: Fully preference-aligned — the patient is already running it across two programs with extensive banked material; blood-based monitoring fits the tissue-scarcity constraint.
